sections.title: The spelling wr
paragraphs: The letters wr sound like /r/. Together they make the sound in the word (wrist) /rɪst/, meaning wrist. This letter group makes only one sound.

sections.title: How to say wr
paragraphs: Curl the tip of your tongue backward near the roof of your mouth. Do not let your tongue touch the roof. Round your lips a little bit. Push air out gently while your vocal cords vibrate. Put a hand on your throat to feel the strong vibration.

sections.title: When wr sounds like r
paragraphs: The letters wr appear at the beginning of words before a vowel. They always make the single sound /r/, as in the word (write) /raɪt/. Another example is the word (wrong) /rɒŋ/. The first letter is silent.

sections.title: Common mistakes with wr
paragraphs: Learners often try to pronounce the first letter before the second letter. Do not close your lips tightly or push out a puff of air. Only make one smooth sound with your tongue curled back, just like in red.
